name: @mnemosyne_os/avatar
_private: Kept private until the npm publication (doc 203 lot 3) is decided: a private package cannot be published by mistake. Remove this flag, and add publishConfig.access=public, on that day only.
description: Mnemosyne Avatar: a face made of particles that looks at you, listens, speaks and reacts. The particle scene, the faces, the gaze and its micro-reactions, the robots and the particle orb, on three.js.
author: XPACEGEMS LLC (https://mnemosyne-os.io)
_repository: Left out until the public repository's name and organisation are decided (doc 203 §8).
_exports: Source, deliberately, like the other workspace packages: every consumer compiles TypeScript already (vite for the app, esbuild for the film pipeline and the Hugging Face demo). `./*` keeps one module per door, so a consumer that needs the point cloud does not pull three.js, and the app's lazy chunks stay as they were.
